Publications

94 peer-reviewed papers since 2002, including 13 in Physical Review Letters, 27 in Physical Review B, 6 in Physical Review Materials and 3 in Nano Letters, and papers in Nature, Nature Materials, Nature Communications, JACS and Advanced Materials.

Citation data on Google Scholar and ORCID. Titles link to the publisher's page; preprints link to arXiv. A BibTeX file of the whole list is available.
